text.en: Clients describe Alison as an approachable, patient, and highly knowledgeable trainer who explains canine psychology clearly. Families appreciate her non-judgmental attitude and clear guidance during one-to-one home sessions. Reviewers note that she creates a supportive learning environment tailored to each household.

Dog owners report rapid improvements in managing puppy manners, recall, and leash reactivity within just a few lessons. Reviewers highlight practical techniques such as crate conditioning and impulse control at doorways. Several owners mention that anxious rescue dogs became significantly calmer and easier to handle on daily walks.

Reviews consistently note the trainer's gentle and calming effect on excitable puppies and nervous rescue dogs. Pets respond well to her positive reinforcement methods without force or stress. Owners observe that their dogs genuinely look forward to her arrival and remain relaxed during practice exercises.

q.en: Does Homeward Hounds provide one-to-one dog training sessions at home?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention private in-home lessons focused on specific puppy manners and behavioural issues.

q.en: Can the trainer help with reactive or nervous rescue dogs?

a.en: Yes, multiple reviewers highlight successful guidance in reducing reactivity and building confidence in rescue pets.

q.en: Are follow-up notes provided after the training lessons?

a.en: Yes, owners appreciate detailed email summaries and practical exercises sent after each session to continue training at home.

q.en: What training techniques are used by Homeward Hounds?

a.en: The trainer uses positive, reward-based methods and simple techniques that make learning enjoyable for both dogs and owners.
